rewrites.//: Client-side routing: every unmatched path serves the SPA shell so a deep link like /dashboard/stock does not 404 on refresh. Static files under /assets are served before rewrites apply, so this does not shadow the bundle.

headers.//: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so a given URL's contents never change and it is safe to cache them permanently.
The shell must never be cached, or a deploy leaves browsers loading an index.html that references bundles which no longer exist.
The app requests geolocation to find nearby pharmacies; everything else is denied.
